project.name: The Social Game
project.description: Event-sourced web game with a generic Livewire dashboard that hosts pluggable game modes built from Challenge and Modifier classes.

primaryRules: All state changes go through Verbs events: fire the event, then Verbs::commit(). Never call $model->save() or Model::update() in business logic.
Livewire + Alpine.js only. Do not introduce other frontend frameworks.
GameDashboard and the other top-level Livewire components are game-agnostic. New game modes ship as new Challenge/Modifier classes; do not modify generic infrastructure to make a feature work.
Every new feature requires Livewire feature tests in tests/Feature/. Unit tests alone do not satisfy the testing requirement; there is no tests/Unit/ by design.
Mirror an existing Challenge/Modifier when adding new ones. Do not invent new patterns when an existing one fits.
tripWireFiles: app/Events/*.php (top-level lifecycle events; game-specific events go under app/Events/<GameMode>/)

keyDirectories.app/Challenges/: Challenge base class + per-game-mode subfolders (PeckingOrder, Farm, Laracon2025, TierList)
keyDirectories.app/Challenges/Support/: Per-game-mode interfaces and traits shared across challenges in that mode
keyDirectories.app/Events/: Verbs events. Top-level files are game-agnostic lifecycle; subfolders are game-specific
keyDirectories.app/Support/FormBuilder.php: Fluent UI builder used by every Challenge/Modifier
keyDirectories.app/Support/FormBuilderElements/: Per-game-mode form element providers, auto-discovered by FormElementRegistry
keyDirectories.resources/views/components/game-componen: Generic game UI (form.blade.php is the renderer)
keyDirectories.tests/Feature/: Feature tests organized by Challenges/, Modifiers/, etc.
keyDirectories.docs/: Architectural docs (architectural-patterns.md is the canonical reference)

verbsLifecycle.handle: Persist by calling $model->updateModelWithStateData() on affected Eloquent models

lifecycleHooks.rule: Always prefer a lifecycle hook over wiring a new event listener

commands.php artisan progress:games: Advance current challenge if time is up

documentation./CLAUDE.md: Non-negotiable rules and trip-wire — read this first
documentation.docs/ai-quick-start.md: Recipes for adding challenges, modifiers, events, custom UI

stalenessPolicy: When this file or any markdown in docs/ contradicts current code, the code is authoritative. Update the doc in your PR and call out the discrepancy.
